translations.web: Yes, those who eat of his dainties will destroy him, and his army will be swept away. Many will fall down slain.
translations.bsb: Those who eat from his provisions will seek to destroy him; his army will be swept away, and many will fall slain.
translations.kjv: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.
